answer: Problem: sybil swarms mint cheap IDs to dominate attest weight. Mechanism: each identity must lock a marble-token collateral into a zenith-height bonding curve keyed by a tundra-region peer map; only peers who already settled ≥2 graded answers in that region may co-sign the lock, and each co-sign burns 0.35 POA. Cost: clones scale O(n) burns plus locked marble. Verification: attests without two live region co-signs and curve height ≥ zenith floor are dropped. Failure: if a co-signer later fails eligibility, 40% of the marble lock slashes and attest weight zeros for 3 epochs.
